description: Why an app sits where it does: score components per category, per-store search ranks, every judge verdict (with reason, whether it is current for the app's present listing and the category's present definition), and the app's change history. An app whose missing_since is set was removed from the App Store (missing_since is the first day we saw it gone, so it is gone since at least then): do not recommend it or send anyone to its store_url.
